title: GOV-0020: research challenge and independence controls are not enforced (RSR-003)
problem:
## Observed
`BADF-WP-0036` (RSR-002) enforced the research contract's record/source/claim controls, but the challenge/independence half (`skills/badf-research/references/acceptance.md` controls 10–13) is not enforced. A research record can assert `independent_primary_sources: 5` while citing one source; a `D4`/`D5` or `R06` record can set `challenge.required: false`; a council can list the researcher as a reviewer or the same identity twice; a ballot can omit its non-coverage. The record has no `researcher` field at all, so RSR-I05 ("the author cannot satisfy required independent challenge") has nothing to compare against.

## Expected
`badf_gate.py research` enforces: `independent_primary_sources` ≤ distinct PRIMARY sources cited (control 10); challenge **required** (computed) at `D4`/`D5` or `R06` (control 11 precondition); when required, a council with ≥2 distinct reviewers, none of them the researcher (RSR-I05, control 11); no duplicate reviewer identity (control 12); every ballot declares `non_coverage` as a list (control 13). A required `researcher` field. A challenged example validated in CI.

## Evidence
`grep -n "researcher" schemas/research-record.schema.json` → absent on `main` at `30160d4`. `validate_research_record` has no council/independence checks.

## Unknowns
None of substance. State-transition (control 16) and traceability (18) remain later WPs; `badf-research` stays `DESIGNED` until all 18 pass.

## Proposed work package
`BADF-WP-0037` (RSR-003). `researcher` field; challenge/council structure validated in code (a nullable object defeats the schema walker); the four controls; a challenged example; tests + mutation. C2.
